[[File:Game_Chambers_map.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Map of the Game Chambers]]
The '''Game Chambers''' of [[Questal/Legends|Questal]] were labyrinth arenas which [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Bandor (Moff)|Bandor]] would throw his prisoners into. He would then hunt them for sport.

Including a space simulator, a laser maze, a pit of winds, a quarry, and a [[Hurlothrumbic Generator]], the chambers were connected by a series of tunnels which the prisoners were forced to traverse if they hoped to survive.

A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members managed to navigate and destroy the maze during a rescue mission for [[Tay Vanis]].
